opening.argument: The video promotes BitClub registration through a payment-linked membership structure: viewers are instructed to “pay 99 membership,” enter personal account credentials, and send Bitcoin through the displayed payment interface. It presents multiple mine-share purchase options with dollar prices and stated daily-profit percentages, while also offering higher-priced participation packages. The arrangement extends beyond payment into recruitment, telling active users that “you can invite your partners using the referral link.” These financial claims and registration conditions are presented as instructions for participation. The service’s performance, wallet ownership, completed losses, and the accuracy of the stated returns are not independently established, but the payment, mining-return, and referral features establish the promotional basis for the alleged scheme.
